verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit keeps much of its output in portable places. Configuration lives as a plain `.coderabbit.yaml` in your own repo (central config repo supported), and `@coderabbitai configuration` returns the resolved config as YAML. Review output (summaries, walkthroughs, inline comments) is posted directly to your Git platform, so it stays with you if you leave. However, nothing documents a data-export feature for CodeRabbit-held data such as learnings, review context or dashboard metrics; retention docs cover deletion/opt-out, not export. Missing for 10: documented export of learnings and knowledge-base data, export of dashboard/analytics data, an explicit account-data export or offboarding path, independent corroboration.
